audit_scope: Independent, read-only audit of frozen M1 data, tokenizer, provenance, code, tests, manifests, 50M selection, handoff, and Definition-of-Done evidence.

score_normalization.method: Each supplied weight was retained and the weighted numerator was divided by 105.

category_scores.evidence: Native-source policy, train-only fitting, and shared-data contract are frozen; incomplete near-pair recall leaves a domain-dependent leakage risk.
Twenty original and fourteen core shards are inventoried and hash-verified; access date is absent and per-source revisions/licenses remain explicitly unavailable.

NFC and conservative whitespace/control handling preserve Azerbaijani orthography; the 50-letter rule is frozen but disproportionately removes mediocore-books fragments, and resumed transformation counters are unavailable.
SHA-256 grouping, deterministic retention, provenance, and 144,480-removal accounting matched SQLite and reports.
The star shortcut in 59 large band buckets had only 1.83% direct recall for eligible true near pairs in the stratified exhaustive sample.
All raw, short, exact, near, retained, and split equations reconcile exactly.
Frozen manifests are deterministically ordered, hash-valid, and observe 90.0055/4.9998/4.9948 percent; known clusters remain intact.
Standard ID/hash/accepted-edge gates pass, but 237 retained representative pairs in sampled large buckets meet the frozen near criterion across splits.
All candidates use the same deterministic one-million-document train-only corpus and matching hashes.
Independent 8K/16K/32K metrics match; Azerbaijani characters and representative suffix-rich words round-trip without unknown pieces.
The 16K BPE loads, special IDs and trainer settings match metadata, and every recorded artifact SHA-256 verifies.
6,194,052 document rows aggregate exactly to 606,218,773 tokens and independent stratified retokenization matched.
Independent replay matched 276,565 IDs, order, group totals, shortage redistribution, and manifest hash exactly.
Seeds, versions, and hashes are strong, but absolute OneDrive paths break relocation and near-band contents are not hash-frozen.
Streaming and deterministic logic are generally sound; the large-bucket shortcut is a correctness defect and resume/rebuild guards are weak.
Core modules use restrained comments and clear names; several report/finalization entry points are oversized and repetitive.
Bounded streaming and batched SQLite/Parquet work are appropriate; a speed shortcut traded away required near-pair recall even though full observed expansion is tractable.
All 18 tests pass, but the suite omits large-bucket recall, true-near cross-split leakage, exact 50M boundary, resume, and relocation behavior.
Numerical artifacts agree, but handoff/DoD/leakage reports now contain semantically stale completion and pass claims exposed by this audit.
Measured tables and four figures are useful, but the near-dedup limitation, transitivity, unknown-rate denominator, and exact 50M boundary need explicit treatment.

implementation.above_hard_cap_behavior: skip and fail the preparation run if any skipped bucket is reported
implementation.anchor_rule: minimum SQLite rowid after sorting bucket members

stratified_exhaustive_sample.scope_warning: This is measured sample recall, not a corpus-wide recall estimate. One 352-document laws bucket accounts for most true pairs.

connected_components.representative_policy: minimum SHA-256 document_id in each accepted-edge connected component
connected_components.interpretation: Connected closure is leakage-protective when candidate recall is adequate, but more aggressive than complete-link clustering and is insufficiently documented.

training_sample.selection_rule: first 1,000,000 rows of the document-id-sorted processed train corpus

unknown_rate_denominators.candidate_audit: unknown pieces divided by encoded SentencePiece pieces across 100,000 train-only audit documents; EOD excluded
unknown_rate_denominators.full_corpus: 2,873 unknown pieces divided by 600,024,721 encoded text pieces; 606,218,773 stored tokens includes one EOD for each of 6,194,052 documents
unknown_rate_denominators.assessment: Values are valid but the denominator distinction is not explicit enough in the human reports.

exact_consumption_boundary.required_m3_policy: Encode documents in frozen manifest order, append exactly one EOD per document, and stop after the first 50,000,000 token IDs.

provenance.per_source_license_revision_status: explicitly unavailable where upstream local metadata does not state it

issues.description: Star expansion for 201-10,000-member band buckets omits most pair combinations and leaves verified retained near pairs across frozen splits.
issues.evidence: Eight stratified bucket-events yielded 28,849 eligible true pairs, 527 direct accepted candidates, and 237 retained cross-split representative pairs meeting the frozen criterion.
issues.scientific_impact: Future validation/test estimates can be biased by high-similarity content shared with train; the effect is domain-dependent and cannot be bounded corpus-wide from the current sample.
issues.engineering_impact: The accepted-edge-only leakage audit, handoff completion flag, and DoD status are not sufficient.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: Raise complete pair expansion to cover the observed maximum bucket size or otherwise use a recall-preserving deterministic candidate strategy; rebuild candidate verification, clusters, split, tokenizer inputs/artifacts, token counts, 50M manifest, reports, handoff, and DoD. Reuse verified normalization, exact-dedup state, fingerprints, and band files after hashing them.

issues.description: Frozen manifests and metadata contain current OneDrive absolute paths, including every processed_file reference.
issues.evidence: At least 183 absolute path occurrences were found; train, validation, test, and train_50m Parquet metadata use the current repository path, while original_dollma is sibling-relative.
issues.scientific_impact: None if the current path is retained; relocation without controlled refreezing can make inputs unreadable or tempt ad hoc path edits.
issues.engineering_impact: The repository is not directly movable to C:/Research and consumable there.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: After the near-dedup correction, store repository-relative processed references or use a documented relocation-aware resolver; configure DOLLMA explicitly, regenerate affected hashes/handoff, then rerun hash, leakage, and test gates.

issues.description: The passing suite does not exercise the branch responsible for the critical candidate-recall failure.
issues.evidence: No test covers star buckets above 200 members, exhaustive candidate recall, transitive cluster topology, true-near pairs outside accepted clusters, exact 50M cutoff, resume integrity, or relocation.
issues.scientific_impact: A leakage-affecting regression passed all 18 tests.
issues.engineering_impact: Future pipeline changes can repeat the defect without detection.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: Add targeted synthetic and frozen-sample regression tests before rerunning downstream M1 stages.

issues.description: Resume validation accepts band files mainly by count/size, several large outputs are not atomically published, and rebuild deletion lacks an explicit workspace-containment guard.
issues.evidence: Static review of preparation, manifest, report, and audit/finalization paths.
issues.scientific_impact: Partial or mismatched state could be mistaken for valid state during the required correction.
issues.engineering_impact: Recovery is less safe than the artifact sizes warrant.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: Hash and bind band files to the frozen config, validate stage invariants before resume, use temporary-plus-replace publication for critical outputs, and validate rebuild targets remain under configured M1 output roots.

issues.description: The overall local DOLLMA license is recorded, but no access date is frozen; per-source licenses and revisions are correctly marked unavailable.
issues.evidence: Source registry, raw inventory, and handoff inspection.
issues.scientific_impact: Low; legal conclusions must not be inferred from missing component metadata.
issues.engineering_impact: Provenance is less complete for a later paper/data card.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: Record the verifiable local acquisition/access date if recoverable; otherwise state that it is unavailable. Keep unknown per-source revisions/licenses explicit.

issues.description: README.md and data/README.md still say preprocessing has not started, and M1 reports do not explain large-bucket recall or component transitivity.
issues.scientific_impact: No direct data change, but readers can misunderstand the frozen state and dedup semantics.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: Update documentation only after corrected M1 artifacts are frozen; distinguish accepted-edge threshold from all-pairs cluster similarity.

issues.description: Candidate unknown rates exclude EOD while full stored token totals include EOD, and the exact 50M inside-document boundary is derivable but not frozen explicitly.
issues.evidence: Candidate recomputation, full count arithmetic, and exact 50M replay.
issues.scientific_impact: No measured tokenizer or sequence error, but ambiguous denominators and cutoff semantics can be misreported or implemented inconsistently.
issues.engineering_impact: M3 must infer the exact boundary behavior.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: Label unknown-rate numerators/denominators and EOD inclusion; record the boundary document, cumulative count, consumed prefix length, and stop rule in the corrected handoff.

issues.description: Resumed normalization transformation counters remain unknown_resumed, and near-band/large CSV evidence is not independently hash-frozen in the handoff.
issues.scientific_impact: Removal accounting is intact, but some transformation-frequency and intermediate provenance details cannot be reconstructed cheaply.
issues.engineering_impact: Intermediate-state validation is weaker than final-artifact validation.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: Disclose unavailable counters rather than rescan raw data; hash retained bands and key intermediate evidence before the focused near-dedup rerun.

issues.description: Several report and handoff entry points contain long main functions and repeated artifact-assembly logic.
issues.evidence: Static review; the largest report main is over 300 lines.
issues.engineering_impact: Future edits are harder to review and test.
issues.exact_recommended_fix: Extract small pure builders when those scripts next require substantive changes; avoid an aesthetics-only rewrite now.

absolute_and_breaking: absolute artifact paths in handoff and tokenizer metadata
absolute_but_harmless: historical provenance paths if no loader consumes them
migration_procedure: Complete the near-dedup correction and downstream refreeze first.
Convert processed references to repository-relative paths or add one documented relocation-aware resolver.
Set the DOLLMA root explicitly or preserve the expected sibling layout.
Regenerate affected hashes, handoff, reports, and DoD once.
Run full hash, leakage, tokenizer-load, subset, and pytest gates before M2/M3.

scientific_confidence.question: Is M1 scientifically valid for the intended PE comparison?
scientific_confidence.evidence: The controlled-data contract is sound, but the demonstrated near-leakage defect must be corrected.

scientific_confidence.question: Could data leakage bias future PE results?
scientific_confidence.evidence: The sample contains 237 retained cross-split representative pairs meeting the frozen near criterion.

scientific_confidence.question: Could tokenizer construction bias one PE variant over another?
scientific_confidence.evidence: All PE variants are assigned the same frozen tokenizer and candidate selection does not depend on PE condition.

scientific_confidence.question: Is the same data and order guaranteed for all PE variants?
scientific_confidence.evidence: The subset order is hash-frozen and model seeds do not enter selection, subject to refreezing after the near-dedup fix.

scientific_confidence.question: Are low-data conditions reproducible?
scientific_confidence.evidence: The 50M sequence replays exactly, but absolute paths and the required data refreeze remain.

scientific_confidence.question: Is translated data correctly excluded?
scientific_confidence.evidence: translated-enwiki is absent from core inventory, processed sources, tokenizer input, and subset.

scientific_confidence.question: Is dedup aggressive enough?
scientific_confidence.evidence: Large-bucket candidate generation misses many true near pairs.

scientific_confidence.question: Is dedup too aggressive?
scientific_confidence.evidence: Connected components remove endpoint pairs below 0.95, though total near removal is only about 0.244% of exact-unique documents.

scientific_confidence.question: Could the short-text filter distort source/domain distribution?
scientific_confidence.evidence: 1,873,780 mediocore-books rows are removed by the 50-letter threshold; the effect is documented but substantial.

scientific_confidence.question: Is the 16K tokenizer choice defensible?
scientific_confidence.evidence: It satisfies the preregistered default, has no technical coverage failure, and candidate metrics were independently reproduced.

scientific_confidence.question: Is the 50M training corpus defensible?
scientific_confidence.evidence: Selection logic and exact boundary replay, but the corpus must be refrozen after leakage correction.

scientific_confidence.question: Can another teammate start M2/M3 without rerunning M1?
scientific_confidence.evidence: The P1 near-leakage issue requires a focused near-dedup and downstream rerun.

scientific_confidence.question: Can the repository be safely moved out of OneDrive now?
scientific_confidence.evidence: Absolute processed_file paths and sibling-relative DOLLMA configuration would break without migration work.

scientific_confidence.question: Are there absolute-path portability risks?
scientific_confidence.evidence: At least 183 occurrences, including data-consuming manifest fields, were found.

scientific_confidence.question: Could anything invalidate the final paper later?
scientific_confidence.evidence: Using the current split after the demonstrated near-leakage finding without correction and disclosure would undermine evaluation integrity.

worth_fixing.item: replace large-bucket star shortcut with recall-preserving expansion

performance.benchmarks: No new performance benchmarks were run; classifications derive from algorithm and persisted workload sizes.

strongest_areas: Raw and critical-artifact hashes independently verify with zero mismatches.
Corpus accounting is exact and mutually reconcilable.
Tokenizer training provenance is train-only, shared, deterministic, and hash-frozen.
The final 16K tokenizer and full token counts independently validate.
The 50M selection and ordering replay exactly, including shortage redistribution and cutoff.
weakest_areas: Large-bucket LSH candidate recall and resulting true-near split leakage.
Accepted-edge-only leakage checks create false confidence.
Tests omit the critical large-bucket branch and true-near leakage property.
Completion documentation, resume safety, and some provenance details are stale or incomplete.
required_rerun_scope: Focused near-candidate verification/clustering and every downstream frozen artifact; do not repeat raw normalization, exact deduplication, fingerprints, or band construction if their hashes and config binding pass.
final_recommendation: Do not begin M2/M3 on the current split. Correct large-bucket candidate generation, add regression tests, refreeze downstream artifacts, make paths relocatable, and then repeat the independent leakage and handoff gates.
